title: Daily Brief — Morning Edition — Wednesday, 30 September 2026
description: Today's stories: Anthropic's IPO prospectus revealing $518 billion in planned AI infrastructure spending, a looming Greens leadership contest after Larissa Waters' departure, the first piece of the Brisbane 2032 Olympic emblem unveiled in Cairns, and the countdown to the Gold Coast's BLEACH Festival opening tomorrow. 오늘의 브리핑은 영어에 이어 한국어로도 제공됩니다.
